notes.title: V1.1 — Smarter, Faster, Financially Aware
notes.description: Version 1.1 brings financial year filtering, unified work management, inline task editing, and smarter Microsoft 365 integration. The dashboard now thinks in financial years, tasks are editable where you find them, and your Microsoft account links itself.

notes.title: Financial Year Filtering
notes.description: The Financial Headline on the home screen now shows numbers for the current financial year (Sep-Aug) only. Revenue, expenses, GP, margins, outstanding, and due amounts are all scoped to FY25/26 with a clear badge indicator.

notes.title: Unified Work (My Work)
notes.description: My Tool and Collaboration Hub are merged into a single 'My Work' cockpit. Home, Calendar, Tasks, and Meetings in one place. Microsoft 365 data syncs every 15 minutes — emails, calendar events, and Teams activity all flow into the dashboard.

notes.title: Inline % Complete Editing
notes.description: Click any task's percentage in the project plan grid to edit it directly — no need to open the task detail. The detail drawer also now has both a slider and number input for precise control. Works for both baseline and operational tasks.

notes.title: Overall Actual vs Expected % Tracking
notes.description: The project plan summary cards now show both 'Actual %' and 'Expected %' with a delta badge. When the project is behind schedule, the Expected % card highlights in amber. Both recalculate automatically when you update task percentages or dates.

notes.title: Auto-Link Microsoft Accounts
notes.description: Set a user's email address in the Microsoft mapping page and their account links automatically on first Microsoft sign-in. No more hunting for Azure AD Object IDs. The status shows 'Awaiting Login' until they sign in, then flips to 'Linked'.

notes.title: Project Tagging & Email-to-Task
notes.description: Tag any Outlook email, Teams message, or SharePoint file to a project. Convert emails and messages into operational or personal tasks with one click. Everything stays linked and traceable.

notes.title: Unified Calendar
notes.description: One calendar view combining Outlook events with all five task types — personal, operational, project plan, engineering, and quality. Color-coded and drag-and-drop ready.

notes.title: Plan Task Inline Editing & COO Notifications
notes.description: Edit plan task fields directly in the grid — status, priority, dates, assignees, and percentage. Non-admin edits trigger a notification to the COO for review and confirmation.

notes.title: Enhanced Permission Controls
notes.description: New permission entities for My Work, MS Sync, and Project Tagging added to the admin roles page. Fine-grained control over who can access unified work features and Microsoft integrations.
